collection_id.missing: Unavailable or not applicable; null is distinct from measured zero.
collection_id.explanation: Each entry describes a column or a repeated family (*). group selects the feature family; role says how the column is used; unit gives its units; missing explains unavailable values. Null means unavailable, not zero. Metadata fields identify samples and record labels, provenance or extraction quality; they are not model inputs.

extraction_common_features_ascii_ratio.explanation: Whole-file byte properties, including size, file signatures and character ratios. These do not depend on successful PDF parsing.

extraction_common_features_byte_histogra.explanation: One normalized frequency per byte value: suffixes 000 through 255 represent decimal byte values. These are byte-distribution features, not counts of PDF objects. 256 normalized byte frequencies in decimal byte-value order; empty input yields zeros.

extraction_common_features_entropy_block.missing: Maximum block entropy in bits per byte.
